$schema.description: A JSON Schema for editors. Ignored by showem.

viewport.description: The page size in CSS pixels. Default: 1440 x 900.

device-scale-factor.description: Pixel density of the recording. Default: 3.

zoom.description: The scale of `zoom: true` steps and `zoom-in`. Default: 1.8.

zoom-hold-ms.description: How long the camera stays zoomed after a step ends. Default: 300.

background.description: An image file shown behind the window.

padding.description: Space around the window, as a share of the video size. Default: 0.08.

radius.description: Corner radius of the window, as a share of the video size. Default: 0.018.

motion-blur.description: 0 (off) to 1 (strong), only while the camera or cursor moves. Default: 0.5.

travel-ms.description: Longest time the pointer takes to move to a target. Default: 800.

font-size.description: In video pixels. Default: 3% of the video height.

style.description: How the video looks. Changing it only needs `showem render`.

bitrate.description: In Mbps. Higher is sharper and bigger. Default: none, quality stays constant and the size follows the content.

output.description: The video file. Each script sets its own path.

provider.description: A service showem knows: elevenlabs, openai or openrouter. For any other server with OpenAI's speech API (Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS, Chatterbox, LiteLLM), leave it out and set `base-url`.

base-url.description: Instead of `provider`: the API root of a server with OpenAI's speech API, like http://localhost:8880/v1. showem sends each caption to <base-url>/audio/speech.

model.description: The model. Required, except with elevenlabs (default: eleven_v4).

voice.description: The voice: an ElevenLabs voice id, or one of the model's voice names.

api-key.description: `${{ env.NAME }}`: the variable with the key, set in `.showem/.env`, the project's `.env` or the environment. Never the key itself. Required with `provider`, optional with `base-url`.

instructions.description: How to speak, in one line, for models that take it (like OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts): "Warm, relaxed product narrator". Not with elevenlabs, which uses `[audio tags]` instead.

extra.description: More fields for each request, sent as they are, for options a server has beyond the usual ones. Example: `instruct: Warm narrator` and `temperature: 0.3` for mlx-audio's Qwen3-TTS.

audio-tags.description: Whether the model performs `[audio tags]` in captions. When false they're taken out before the caption is said. Default: true for ElevenLabs v3 and v4 models, false for everything else.

voice.description: Narration read aloud over the video.
